1.title: Willkommen bei Supplier Passport
1.text: Diese Tour zeigt Ihnen, wie Sie einen kaeuferbereiten Supplier Passport erstellen.

2.title: Bereitschaftswert
2.text: Dieser Wert zeigt, wie vollstaendig Ihr Fragebogen und Ihre Nachweisbereitschaft sind.

3.text: Nutzen Sie diese Empfehlung, um dort weiterzumachen, wo die groesste Luecke besteht.

5.text: Jeder Abschnitt wirkt sich auf Ihren Bereitschaftswert aus.

6.title: Antworten speichern
6.text: Speichern Sie Ihre Antworten regelmaessig. Gespeicherte Antworten bleiben nach dem Aktualisieren erhalten.

7.text: Laden Sie Nachweisdokumente wie Zertifikate, Richtlinien und Rechnungen hoch.

8.title: Dokumente hochladen

helperTexts.energyTip: Berichten Sie Energiedaten für Ihre gesamte Organisation für die letzten 12 Monate. Nutzen Sie nach Möglichkeit Zählerstände, Rechnungen oder Daten aus Energiemanagementsystemen.
helperTexts.energy-total-consumption: Enter total energy consumption across all included sources. This should be consistent with the individual energy figures where available.
helperTexts.energy-intensity: Enter intensity, such as energy per employee, site or production unit. Use the same basis each year so changes can be compared.
helperTexts.energy-primary-source: Explain was ist ihre wichtigste quelle für bezogene energie for the selected reporting period and boundary. Use reliable energy records where available, enter 0 when none occurred, or leave blank if the data is not tracked yet.
helperTexts.energy-renewable-onsite: Answer whether renewable energy is produced or used at your own sites. Examples include solar PV, biomass or other on-site renewable systems.
helperTexts.energy-renewable-percentage: Enter the share of energy from renewable sources if known. Use certificates, supplier declarations, green tariffs or metered generation records as evidence.
helperTexts.energy-audit-date: Enter the date of the latest energy audit, review or assessment. Leave blank if no audit or review has been completed.
helperTexts.energy-efficiency-measures: Select or describe energy efficiency measures that are already implemented. Evidence can include project plans, invoices, photos or internal reports.
helperTexts.energy-additional-notes: Add assumptions, estimates or context for energy data. Use this field to explain unavailable data or changes in scope.
helperTexts.company_reporting_year: Enter the calendar or financial year covered by this questionnaire. Use the same reporting year across all sections.
helperTexts.company_period_start: Enter the first day of the reporting period. This should match the period used for employee, energy, waste and other data.
helperTexts.company_period_end: Enter the last day of the reporting period. If the period is shorter than 12 months, explain that in a note where possible.
helperTexts.company_legal_name: Enter the full legal company name as shown on registration, tax or VAT documents. Avoid trade names unless they are the registered legal name.
helperTexts.company_registration_number: Enter the registration, VAT, OIB or equivalent company identifier. Use the identifier buyers can match against official records.
helperTexts.company_country: Enter the country where the company is legally registered or primarily operates. If the group spans several countries, use the reporting boundary selected below.
helperTexts.company_city: Enter the headquarters city or main operating location. This helps buyers understand the location context of the Supplier Passport.
helperTexts.company_main_activity: Describe the main industry, product or service your company provides. Keep it short and buyer-friendly.
helperTexts.company_sites_count: Enter the number of operating sites included in this questionnaire. Include offices, production sites, warehouses or service locations inside the reporting boundary.
helperTexts.company_reporting_boundary: Select whether answers cover only this company, a group, or specific sites. Use the same boundary consistently across all sections.
helperTexts.company_reporting_module: Select the questionnaire level you are preparing. If unsure, start with the basic module and expand when buyers request more detail.
helperTexts.company_sustainability_contact: Enter the person or team buyers can contact for sustainability or supplier requests. Use a role mailbox if that is easier to maintain.
helperTexts.employees_total_headcount: Enter the total number of people employed during the reporting period, using the HR definition your company normally uses. If exact data is unavailable, use the best available HR summary.
helperTexts.employees_full_time: Enter the number of full-time employees included in the headcount. Use HR or payroll summaries as supporting evidence if available.
helperTexts.employees_part_time: Enter the number of part-time employees included in the reporting boundary. Enter 0 if there were none during the period.
helperTexts.employees_temporary: Enter temporary, seasonal or agency workers if tracked separately. Leave blank if this category is not tracked.
helperTexts.employees_gender_split_available: Answer whether gender split data is available in your HR records. Do not enter personal data; use aggregated summaries only.
helperTexts.employees_turnover_rate: Enter employee turnover rate if your HR team calculates it. Leave blank if it is not currently tracked.
helperTexts.employees_training_provided: Answer whether training was provided during the reporting year. Evidence may include training records, attendance summaries or policy documents.
helperTexts.employees_collective_bargaining: Answer whether collective bargaining or worker representation applies to your workforce. Use HR or legal summaries if available.
helperTexts.employees_equal_pay_tracking: Answer whether remuneration, equal pay or pay-gap indicators are tracked internally. Use aggregated data only.
helperTexts.employees_workforce_policies: Answer whether workforce policies are documented, such as employment, health, diversity or grievance policies. Upload current policy documents if available.
helperTexts.energy_electricity_consumption: Enter the headquarters city or main operating location. This helps buyers understand the location context of the Supplier Passport.
helperTexts.energy_natural_gas_consumption: Enter natural gas consumption for the same reporting period and boundary. Enter 0 if natural gas is not used.
helperTexts.energy_district_heating_cooling: Enter district heating or cooling consumption if used. Leave blank or enter 0 if it does not apply to your sites.
helperTexts.energy_total_consumption: Enter total energy consumption across all included sources. This should be consistent with the individual energy figures where available.
helperTexts.energy_consumption_intensity: Enter intensity, such as energy per employee, site or production unit. Use the same basis each year so changes can be compared.
helperTexts.energy_primary_source: Select the main source of purchased energy. If several sources are similar, choose the largest by consumption and explain in notes if needed.
helperTexts.energy_onsite_renewable: Answer whether renewable energy is produced or used at your own sites. Examples include solar PV, biomass or other on-site renewable systems.
helperTexts.energy_renewable_percentage: Enter the share of energy from renewable sources if known. Use certificates, supplier declarations, green tariffs or metered generation records as evidence.
helperTexts.energy_scope1_emissions: Enter Scope 1 emissions only if your company calculates them. Leave blank if not calculated; do not guess without a method.
helperTexts.energy_scope2_emissions: Enter Scope 2 emissions only if calculated from purchased electricity, heat or cooling. Use the same method consistently over time.
helperTexts.energy_ghg_method: Name the method, tool or emission factors used for GHG calculations. This helps buyers understand how the numbers were prepared.
helperTexts.energy_last_audit: Enter the date of the latest energy audit, review or assessment. Leave blank if no audit or review has been completed.
helperTexts.energy_efficiency_measures: Select or describe energy efficiency measures that are already implemented. Evidence can include project plans, invoices, photos or internal reports.
helperTexts.energy_reduction_initiatives: Describe planned or active initiatives to reduce energy use or GHG emissions. Keep the answer factual and avoid future guarantees.
helperTexts.energy_additional_notes: Add assumptions, estimates or context for energy data. Use this field to explain unavailable data or changes in scope.
helperTexts.fuel_company_vehicles_count: Enter the number of company-owned or leased vehicles in the reporting boundary. Enter 0 if the company has no vehicles.
helperTexts.fuel_diesel_consumption: Enter diesel use for company vehicles or equipment during the reporting period. Use fuel cards, invoices or fleet logs where available.
helperTexts.fuel_petrol_consumption: Enter petrol or gasoline use for the reporting period. Enter 0 if petrol is not used.
helperTexts.fuel_lpg_cng_consumption: Enter LPG or CNG use if applicable. Leave blank or enter 0 if these fuels are not used.
helperTexts.fuel_ev_electricity_use: Enter the headquarters city or main operating location. This helps buyers understand the location context of the Supplier Passport.
helperTexts.fuel_business_travel_tracking: Answer whether business travel data is tracked, such as flights, mileage, rail or hotel records. Use aggregated travel reports if available.
helperTexts.fuel_logistics_subcontractor_tracking: Answer whether logistics or transport subcontractor data is collected. Evidence may include carrier reports, invoices or shipment summaries.
helperTexts.fuel_data_source: State the main source used for fuel or travel data, such as fuel cards, invoices, fleet software or estimates. Mention estimates if actual data is unavailable.
helperTexts.waste_total_generated: Enter total waste generated during the reporting period. Use waste contractor reports, invoices or internal logs where available.
helperTexts.waste_hazardous_generated: Enter hazardous waste if your company generates or tracks it. Enter 0 if no hazardous waste was generated.
helperTexts.waste_non_hazardous_generated: Enter hazardous waste if your company generates or tracks it. Enter 0 if no hazardous waste was generated.
helperTexts.waste_recycled_recovered: Enter waste sent to recycling, recovery or reuse if tracked. Evidence may include contractor statements or waste transfer notes.
helperTexts.waste_disposed: Enter waste sent to disposal, landfill or incineration without recovery if tracked. Use contractor reports where possible.
helperTexts.waste_main_streams: Describe the main waste types, such as packaging, metal, paper, plastics, chemicals or general waste. Keep the answer practical and concise.
helperTexts.waste_packaging_applicable: Answer whether packaging waste is relevant to your operations or products. If not applicable, select no or explain briefly.
helperTexts.waste_contractor_documentation: Answer whether you have documentation from waste contractors. Examples include invoices, collection notes, permits or annual summaries.
helperTexts.waste_circular_initiatives: Describe reuse, repair, recycling or circular economy initiatives already in place. Avoid claims that cannot be supported.
helperTexts.env_policy_exists: Answer whether a current policy exists for this topic. Upload the latest approved policy if available.
helperTexts.env_climate_energy_targets: Answer whether the company has approved climate or energy reduction targets. Include only targets that are approved or actively tracked.
helperTexts.env_pollution_relevant: Answer whether air, water or soil pollution is relevant to your operations. If not relevant, select no and keep the scope consistent.
helperTexts.env_pollution_permits_monitoring: Answer whether permits, monitoring or inspections apply to pollution topics. Evidence can include permits, monitoring reports or inspection records.
helperTexts.env_water_tracked: Answer whether water withdrawal or consumption is tracked. Use meter data, bills or internal records if available.
helperTexts.env_water_consumption: Enter water consumption if tracked for the reporting period. Leave blank if water data is not currently available.
helperTexts.env_biodiversity_sensitive_sites: Answer whether operations are near protected or biodiversity-sensitive areas. Use site assessments, permits or public maps if available.
helperTexts.env_incidents_reporting_year: Enter the calendar or financial year covered by this questionnaire. Use the same reporting year across all sections.
helperTexts.env_fines_penalties: Enter fines or penalties during the reporting period, if any. Enter 0 if none were recorded.
helperTexts.env_planned_initiatives: Describe planned environmental improvements or initiatives. Keep the answer factual and avoid promises that are not approved.
helperTexts.hs_policy_exists: Answer whether a current policy exists for this topic. Upload the latest approved policy if available.
helperTexts.hs_work_related_injuries: Enter the number of work-related injuries recorded during the reporting period. Enter 0 if none were recorded.
helperTexts.hs_recordable_accidents: Enter recordable accidents using the definition your company applies internally. Use safety logs or HR summaries where available.
helperTexts.hs_lost_time_injuries: Enter the number of work-related injuries recorded during the reporting period. Enter 0 if none were recorded.
helperTexts.hs_fatalities: Enter work-related fatalities during the reporting period. Enter 0 if none occurred.
helperTexts.hs_absence_rate: Enter sickness or absence rate if tracked by HR. Leave blank if it is not available.
helperTexts.hs_training_provided: Answer whether training was provided during the reporting year. Evidence may include training records, attendance summaries or policy documents.
helperTexts.hs_risk_assessments_completed: Answer whether risk assessments are completed for relevant operations. Evidence can include risk registers, assessments or procedure documents.
helperTexts.hs_certifications_inspections: Enter relevant health and safety certificates, inspections or review results if applicable. Upload certificates or inspection summaries where available.
helperTexts.cert_iso_9001: Answer whether the company holds an ISO 9001 certificate. Upload the current certificate and check the expiry date if available.
helperTexts.cert_iso_14001: Answer whether the company holds an ISO 14001 environmental management certificate. Upload the current certificate if available.
helperTexts.cert_iso_45001: Answer whether the company holds an ISO 45001 health and safety certificate. Upload the current certificate if available.
helperTexts.cert_iso_50001: Answer whether the company holds an ISO 50001 energy management certificate. Upload the current certificate if available.
helperTexts.cert_esg_rating: Enter ESG ratings or assessments such as EcoVadis, CDP or similar if available. Include rating year and evidence where possible.
helperTexts.cert_industry_specific: Enter industry-specific certificates relevant to buyers, products or services. Upload certificates if available.
helperTexts.cert_expiry_tracked: Answer whether certificate expiry dates are tracked internally. This helps avoid sharing outdated evidence.
helperTexts.cert_documents_uploaded: Answer whether certificate documents have been uploaded to the Evidence Data Room. Upload missing certificates before buyer review if available.
helperTexts.cert_insurance_compliance_uploaded: Answer whether insurance or compliance documents have been uploaded when relevant to buyers. Leave blank if not applicable.
helperTexts.gov_code_of_conduct: Answer whether the company has a code of conduct or ethics policy. Upload the current document if available.
helperTexts.gov_anti_corruption_policy: Answer whether anti-corruption or anti-bribery rules are documented. Evidence may include policies, training records or control procedures.
helperTexts.gov_whistleblowing_channel: Answer whether employees or third parties can report concerns through a documented channel. Do not include personal case details.
helperTexts.gov_corruption_convictions: Enter any corruption or bribery convictions during the reporting period. Enter 0 if none occurred.
helperTexts.gov_corruption_fines: Enter fines or penalties during the reporting period, if any. Enter 0 if none were recorded.
helperTexts.gov_data_protection_policy: Answer whether a data protection or GDPR policy exists. Upload the policy or related procedure if available.
helperTexts.gov_sanctions_screening: Answer whether sanctions or export-control screening is relevant and performed. Evidence may include procedure documents or screening records.
helperTexts.gov_compliance_responsible_person: Enter whether a person or role is responsible for compliance topics. Use a role title or team name if you prefer not to name an individual.
helperTexts.gov_audit_readiness: Enter the date of the latest energy audit, review or assessment. Leave blank if no audit or review has been completed.
helperTexts.supplier_main_suppliers_identified: Answer whether your main suppliers are identified and tracked. Use supplier lists or procurement records if available.
helperTexts.supplier_critical_suppliers_identified: Answer whether critical suppliers are identified based on spend, dependency, risk or business importance. Use your existing procurement definition.
helperTexts.supplier_country_risk_tracked: Enter the country where the company is legally registered or primarily operates. If the group spans several countries, use the reporting boundary selected below.

admin.pilotInvitationSubject: Invitation to complete your Supplier Passport profile
admin.pilotInvitationBody:
Hello,

we have prepared access to your Supplier Passport workspace.

The goal is to enter your basic company information, complete the VSME questionnaire, upload available supporting evidence and prepare a buyer-safe summary that you can share with customers.

Suggested order:
1. Complete Company Basics
2. Complete the questionnaire sections
3. Upload available documents and certificates
4. Link documents to answers where required
5. Review Supplier Passport
6. Create a public link or download the PDF summary

Private evidence documents are not publicly downloadable without additional approval. The public link shows a buyer-safe summary and evidence availability.

If you get stuck, use the "Contact support" option inside the application.

Best regards,

admin.buyerDemoScriptCopyError: We could not copy the buyer demo script right now.
admin.buyerDemoScriptBody:
Intro:
Supplier Passport is a buyer-safe summary of supplier readiness, section status, evidence availability and certificate expiry signals. It is not a certification, audit or assurance report.

What the buyer sees:
- Readiness score and section status
- Supplier company data and logo when available
- Evidence availability and certificate expiry status
- Evidence Index when enabled, without download URLs
- Request additional information copy flow
- Buyer-safe PDF summary

Privacy boundary:
The public link does not automatically give the buyer access to private documents. Private evidence files are available only on request or with additional supplier approval.

20-minute flow:
0-3 min: Explain the problem: repeated supplier questionnaires, evidence requests, certificates and follow-up.
3-8 min: Show the public Supplier Passport.
8-12 min: Show evidence availability or Evidence Index.
12-15 min: Show PDF and request-additional-information flow.
15-20 min: Ask validation questions.

Validation questions:
1. Is the Supplier Passport summary understandable without additional explanation?
2. Which information helps you most when assessing a supplier?
3. What is missing?
4. Is the readiness percentage useful, or would you prefer section-level status?
5. Are the sections clear enough?
6. Would you like to see a structured evidence index?
7. Which documents would you most often request from suppliers?
8. Is "available on request" enough, or would you want direct download after approval?
9. Would this reduce emails and Excel questionnaires with suppliers?
10. Would you ask suppliers to use this kind of Supplier Passport?
11. What would be required for you to use this in a real process?
12. Would you pay for this as a buyer tool, supplier tool, or through a partner/consultant?
